title: Institute of Health header
description: Two navs in one. Phones: a fixed 64px top bar with the wordmark and a 'Menu' label beside a two-line burger, see-through with light text over the first screen and page-grey after it; the burger opens a full-screen list of large links. From 1024px: a flat 60px bar docked to the bottom of the window with the wordmark, five centred small links, two more on the right and a dark login button; it slides down out of view while you scroll down and comes back when you scroll up.
notes: needs JavaScript for the menu, the hide-on-scroll and the colour switch (hydrate: load)
fixed: it takes no space; the first section sits under the phone bar
the phone bar's light text over the first screen expects a dark hero (it uses highlight-foreground); set overMedia={false} otherwise
